issues.title: Login returns 401 after v1.4.0
issues.body: Existing sessions fail immediately after deploying v1.4.0. New logins also fail. v1.3.9 worked. First observed at 2026-10-12T10:02:00Z. Error: SESSION_EXPIRED.

issues.title: Slow product image loading
issues.body: Product thumbnails take two seconds to load on mobile.

commits.message: refactor(auth): inject clock into session validation

42.author: demo-maintainer
42.body: Session expiry is stored in epoch seconds. The injected clock returns milliseconds. Check the comparison before blaming token signing.
